top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as US-Iran Strikes Spur Rally in Oil
top_signals.summary:
A flare-up in geopolitical risks sent stocks and bonds lower as oil climbed, raising concerns about inflationary pressures that could make the Federal Reserve raise interest rates.
Tracie McMillion, Head of Global Asset Allocation Strategy at Wells Fargo, discusses the constructive backdrop for stocks and commodities. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: War, Weather Push Crop Prices to Biggest Monthly Gain Since 2012
top_signals.summary: Crop prices are set to cap their biggest monthly jump in more than a decade as wars and extreme weather disrupt supplies, raising concerns about food inflation.

top_signals.title: Peak Season Is Coming – But Where Is The Freight Surge?
top_signals.summary:
Peak season is upon us, but SONAR data reveals a surprising trend: tender rejection rates aren’t surging into Labor Day like previous years. While spot rates remain elevated year-over-year, the expected pre-holiday peak isn’t materializing. top_signals.title: SEC Tees Up Plan to Scrap Shareholder Proxy Proposal Rules
top_signals.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission is planning to scrap rules governing how and when public company shareholders can bring proxy proposals, according to a new post by the Office of Management and Budget.

top_signals.title: Kalshi issues first permanent ban to former Rep. George Santos over State of the Union trading
top_signals.summary: Former U.S. Rep. George Santos has been permanently banned from trading on Kalshi, marking the platform’s first-ever permanent ban.
